description: List the option vocabulary (product-option) of one rikma: axes like size / colour, each with its values (value, label, hex, image). These are the axes a product declares it uses (product.options) and the `axisKey` of a variant is built from them. Members only. Use it to see what size M really is before writing a variant that claims it. Docs: https://1lev1.com/mcp#listRikmaProductOptionsTool
name: listRikmaProductOptionsTool
